name: Panamericansaurus
sum: Panamericansaurus is a titanosaur from the Campanian-Maastrichtian Allen Formation of Neuquen, Argentina, close to Aeolosaurus.
wsnote: Estimated length of the holotype individual (Wikipedia revision); the humerus is 123 cm long.
holotype: MUCPv-417, found in June 2003 near San Patricio del Chañar.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Calvo and Porfiri 2010

sources.text: Calvo, J.O. 2010. ''Panamericansaurus schroederi'' gen. nov. sp. nov. Un nuevo Sauropoda (Titanosauridae-Aeolosaurini) de la Provincia del Neuquén, Cretácico Superior de Patagonia, Argentina. Brazilian Geographical Journal: Geosciences and Humanities Research Medium 1: 100–115.
